summary: Tested the new NotificationBell (header bell + popover + deep-link + Done button) and its two new endpoints (GET /api/follow-ups/pending, PATCH /api/customers/{id}/follow-ups/{fid}). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASSED — pending list excludes Completed, sort order (past-due > today > upcoming > unscheduled) verified, PATCH stamps completed_at/by/by_name, 400/404 validation works, and sales+accounts role parity confirmed. Frontend (admin): bell renders, badge shows correct count, /follow-ups/pending polled on page load, popover groups by bucket, row content (customer_name + tower-unit, status badge, stage, date+time, notes) all correct, Done button optimistically removes row + persists Completed status server-side (still appears in customer.follow_ups history but NOT in /pending). HOWEVER one CRITICAL UI bug was discovered: clicking the row body triggers an uncaught React runtime error (insertBefore NotFoundError) because the popover row uses a <button> wrapping another <button> (the Done Button). This is also an HTML hydration warning seen in console. As a side-effect, after navigation completes the React tree dies and the entire page becomes an error overlay — preventing sales/accounts role parity checks via UI (they were verified via backend pytest instead).

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid nested <button> inside another <button>. The row is rendered as <button data-testid=notification-item-...> and contains the <Button data-testid=notification-complete-...> Done component (which renders as <button>). This produces a React hydration warning ('<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>') AND causes an uncaught runtime error 'NotFoundError: Failed to execute insertBefore on Node' during the post-click DOM reconciliation when the popover closes and navigation runs. Result: after a successful deep-link click the entire UI is replaced with the dev error overlay until next reload.

action_items: Replace the outer <button> of notification-item with a <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> (with onClick + onKeyDown for Enter/Space). Keep the inner Button untouched and keep data-testid='notification-item-{id}' on the wrapper. This eliminates the nested-button hydration warning AND fixes the insertBefore crash on navigation.
Optional follow-up: split NotificationBell.jsx if it grows beyond ~250 lines (currently ~265; close to threshold).
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.jsx L189-253: <button> wrapping another <Button> (renders <button>) is invalid HTML. Triggers React DOM reconciliation crash post-navigation. Fix: switch the row to <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={Enter/Space->open}>.
GET /api/follow-ups/pending does an O(N) full scan over every customer with follow_ups. Fine today (~30 customers); revisit with $unwind+$match aggregation as data grows.

PATCH endpoint sets completed_at/by/by_name to None when status changes from Completed back to a non-Completed state — silently overwriting any pre-existing history. Acceptable for current use case (only Mark Completed), but worth a comment so a future role-toggle doesn't leak audit data.
Polling interval of 60s is hardcoded; consider exposing it via a constant or env-driven feature flag.
NotificationBell silently swallows fetch errors (`catch {}`) — acceptable to avoid logout flicker but should at least log once at info level for diagnostics.

success_rate.frontend: Admin flow 100% PASS for bell/popover/Done/deep-link; sales+accounts UI parity COULD NOT be verified due to runtime crash described above (role parity proven at API layer via pytest).

The NotificationBell front-end works end-to-end EXCEPT the row wrapper uses <button> + nested <Button>; clicking the row navigates correctly (URL gets ?tab=notes&focus=<fid> and Notes tab auto-activates with FollowUpTracker visible) but React crashes immediately after, replacing the page with the dev error overlay. rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the post-navigation crash: HTML spec disallows nested interactive <button> elements. Browsers re-parent the inner <button> outside the outer one during initial parse, so React's virtual DOM and the actual DOM tree diverge. When the popover unmounts during route change, React tries to remove the inner <button> using `parentNode.insertBefore(...)` relative to a sibling that no longer matches its bookkeeping → NotFoundError. Fix: outer wrapper must be <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> (with Enter/Space keyboard handler for accessibility). The fix is a 4-line change and does not require touching backend, tests, or routing logic.
